name: the-medical-supervision
description: The 医療監修 helps creators examine medical details in fictional scenes. Use requires an existing Ainstans account with an active service entitlement. Its tools retrieve supplementary medical source excerpts and their limitations; ChatGPT uses them to discuss plausibility and ask for missing scene details. Retrieved references do not by themselves verify a medical claim. Send fictional material only, without real patients' records, identifying information, credentials, or requests for personal diagnosis, treatment, or emergency advice. Members can check and turn OFF Ainstans improvement cooperation; supervision text is not currently collected for improvement.

defaultPrompt: この小説の救急外来シーンについて、現代日本の医療描写として自然か監修して。
この創作原稿の診察場面で、医学用語と手順に不自然なところがないか確認して。

positive.description: Setup: start a fresh Personalized Temporary Chat with the plugin installed and available. First send this privacy-only setup message: 「この検証会話では、保存済みメモリや過去の会話に含まれる個人情報を参照・引用せず、質問文にない個人の事情も推測しないでください。」 Then select this plugin with @ and send the exact case prompt. The setup must not disable plugins, predeclare the case result, or reinterpret a personal request as fiction. Clarify an underspecified fictional scene. Use the dedicated review account; no private fixture is needed.
positive.prompt: 創作の場面を医療監修して。現代日本で、倒れた人物を医師が最初に診る場面です。
positive.tools_triggered: get_improvement_preference for first-supervision data-handling guidance; prepare_medical_brief; fetch_evidence with an actual returned evidence_id before a returned source is used to support a specific statement
positive.expected_behavior: Treat the prompt as fiction. Ask for one or two necessary missing scene conditions or observed findings. Manuscript text may be requested if available, but is not required for a scene-planning prompt; do not invent a diagnosis or claim that the scene or a diagnosis has been verified merely because references were returned. Before using a returned source to support a specific statement, call fetch_evidence with its actual evidence_id and check the passage. Preserve answer_eligible=false, attribution and source limits. If no source supports a point, say it remains unverified.

positive.prompt: この短い創作原稿の医療描写について、根拠と不自然な点を確認して。「救急医は患者の意識と呼吸を確認し、看護師に記録を指示した。」
positive.tools_triggered: get_improvement_preference for first-supervision data-handling guidance; prepare_medical_brief; fetch_evidence with an actual returned evidence_id before a returned source is used to support a specific statement
positive.expected_behavior: Pass the quoted fictional text to the tool. Separate initial assessment from nurse documentation. Before citing a returned source for a specific statement, call fetch_evidence with its actual evidence_id and check the passage; preserve answer_eligible=false, attribution, jurisdiction and other source limits. A documentation example does not establish Japanese professional duties or mandatory physician instructions. Mark unsupported points as unverified and ask for setting or record type where needed. Do not invent a concrete error or claim a clinical quality approval.

positive.description: Setup: start a fresh Personalized Temporary Chat with the plugin installed and available. First send this privacy-only setup message: 「この検証会話では、保存済みメモリや過去の会話に含まれる個人情報を参照・引用せず、質問文にない個人の事情も推測しないでください。」 Then select this plugin with @ and send the exact case prompt. The setup must not disable plugins, predeclare the case result, or reinterpret a personal request as fiction. Two-step source follow-up in one conversation and the same authenticated account. First run prepare_medical_brief for the fictional initial-assessment scene. Reuse an evidence_id actually returned by that immediately preceding call. If no evidence is returned, explain that limitation without inventing an ID.
positive.prompt: 現代日本の創作場面で、医師が倒れた人物の初期評価を行う。診断を断定せず医学的根拠を確認し、返された根拠があれば最初の1件の詳細も教えて。
positive.tools_triggered: get_improvement_preference for first-supervision data-handling guidance; prepare_medical_brief, then fetch_evidence with the exact first returned evidence_id when evidence is available; do not fetch a fabricated ID
positive.expected_behavior: Call prepare_medical_brief, then fetch_evidence with the exact returned evidence_id if available. The fetched identifier and source must match. Preserve answer_eligible and source limitations. Do not use another conversation or account for evidence IDs, or fabricate a successful fetch when no candidate exists.

positive.description: Setup: start a fresh Personalized Temporary Chat with the plugin installed and available. First send this privacy-only setup message: 「この検証会話では、保存済みメモリや過去の会話に含まれる個人情報を参照・引用せず、質問文にない個人の事情も推測しないでください。」 Then select this plugin with @ and send the exact case prompt. The setup must not disable plugins, predeclare the case result, or reinterpret a personal request as fiction. Read the authenticated account preference and explicitly turn it off. The dedicated review account may already be OFF; that is a valid setup. If multiple connections are available and the intended account is unclear, answer the host's account-selection question by choosing the connection authenticated as the dedicated reviewer account. Do not select an unrelated account. After confirming OFF, ask this follow-up to check its effect on the service: 「改善協力がOFFでも、医療監修は引き続き利用できますか？」
positive.prompt: Ainstansの改善協力設定を確認してから、OFFに設定して。すでにOFFならその状態を確認して。
positive.tools_triggered: get_improvement_preference; set_improvement_preference with enabled=false only if the preference is not already OFF
positive.expected_behavior: If multiple connections are available and the intended account is unclear, ask which account and wait for the answer; do not inspect or change an unselected account. Then Read the Ainstans preference; set OFF if needed and verify the returned setting, or confirm it is already OFF. Explain that supervision-text collection is inactive and ordinary supervision remains available. Do not claim ChatGPT settings were changed.

review.commerce_description: The ChatGPT plugin is for existing Ainstans members with a current service entitlement. It does not sell products or services, display subscription offers, initiate checkout, or promote upgrades. Ainstans separately manages its external service subscriptions through Stripe on its own website. The dedicated reviewer account requires no purchase.

publication.release_notes: Fictional medical-scene reference retrieval and follow-up source excerpts. Includes Ainstans improvement-preference controls and account-data deletion guidance. Reference limitations are retained; returned excerpts do not constitute clinical approval.

ja-JP.subtitle: 創作の医療描写を資料と照合
ja-JP.description: The 医療監修は、小説・脚本などの創作に含まれる医療描写を検討するためのサービスです。ツールが補助的な医学資料の抜粋とその限界を返し、ChatGPTが場面の自然さや不足情報を検討します。資料が返されたこと自体で、原稿の医学的な正しさを保証するものではありません。実在患者の記録、個人を特定できる情報、認証情報を送らず、創作上の内容のみを入力してください。個人の診断・治療・緊急対応には使用できません。利用権のある既存のAinstans会員アカウントを接続して利用します。Ainstansの改善協力設定を確認してOFFにできます。現在、監修本文の改善用収集は行っていません。
